# Wczytanie danych

```{r}

set.seed(2027)

dane_modelowe <- readRDS("dane/dane_modelowe.rds")

split <- readRDS("dane/split.rds")

train <- training(split)
validation <- validation(split)
test <- testing(split)

# weryfikacja zbioru walidacyjnego
validation_set_tuning <- validation_set(split)

v <- assessment(validation_set_tuning$splits[[1]])

# Sprawdzenie liczby wierszy i kolumn
dim(v)
dim(validation)

# Sprawdzenie identyczności zbiorów walidacyjnych
all.equal(v, validation)

metryki <- metric_set(rsq, mae, rmse, mape)

# split do early stopping
set.seed(2027)

train_split <- initial_split(
  train,
  prop = 0.9,
  strata = car_price
)

train90 <- training(train_split)
train_es <- testing(train_split)

cat("Train: ", nrow(train90), "\n",
    "Train early stopping: ", nrow(train_es), "\n", sep = "")

options(scipen = 999)
```

# Budowa modeli

## Regresja liniowa z Elastic Net

```{r}

gc()

callr::r(function()
{
  
  cores <- 6
  
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidymodels)
  library(embed)
  library(glmnet)
  library(future)
  set.seed(2027)
  
  
  split <- readRDS("dane/split.rds")
  
  train <- training(split)
  validation <- validation(split)
  test <- testing(split)
  
  cat("Train:       ", nrow(train), "\n",
      "Validation:  ", nrow(validation), "\n",
      "Test:        ", nrow(test), "\n", sep = "")
  
  # weryfikacja zbioru walidacyjnego
  validation_set_tuning <- validation_set(split = split)
  
  v <- assessment(validation_set_tuning$splits[[1]])
  
  # sprawdzenie liczby wierszy i kolumn
  dim(v)
  dim(validation)
  
  # sprawdzenie identyczności zbiorów walidacyjnych
  all.equal(v, validation)
  
  metryki <- metric_set(rsq, mae, rmse, mape)
  
  
  elastic_net_model <- linear_reg(
    penalty = tune(), # siła regularyzacji na zbiorze walidacyjnym
    mixture = tune()  # 0 = Ridge, 1 = Lasso, pomiędzy = Elastic Net
  ) |> 
    set_engine("glmnet") |> 
    set_mode("regression")
  
  
  recipe_elastic_net <- recipe(car_price ~ ., data = train) |>
    
    # Ochrona przed nowymi kategoriami
    step_novel(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "inne") |>
    
    # Ochrona przed brakami danych
    step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "nieznane") |>
    
    # Target encoding dla marki i modelu przez generalizowany model mieszany
    step_lencode_mixed(make, model, outcome = vars(car_price)) |>
    
    # Grupowanie do kategorii "inne" dla rzadkich kategorii poniżej 0,1%
    step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.001, other = "inne") |>
    
    # Zamiana pozostałych zmiennych kategorycznych na zmienne binarne
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = FALSE) |> 
    
    # Profilaktyczne usuwanie stałych kolumn
    step_zv(all_predictors()) |> 
    
    # Normalizacja predyktorów numerycznych
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
  
  
  
  recipe_prepped_elastic_net <- prep(recipe_elastic_net, training = train)
  
  train_processed <- bake(recipe_prepped_elastic_net, new_data = NULL)
  
  head(train_processed)
  
  
  elastic_net_wflow <- workflow() |>
    add_recipe(recipe_elastic_net) |>
    add_model(elastic_net_model)
  
  
  # Siatka regularna (6 x 5)
  elastic_net_grid <- grid_regular(
    penalty(range = c(-5, 0)), # od 0.00001 (słaba kara) do 1 (silna kara)
    mixture(range = c(0, 1)),  # Od 0 (Ridge) do 1 (Lasso)
    levels = c(penalty = 6, mixture = 5)
  )
  
  plan(multisession, workers = cores)
  
  gc()
  set.seed(2027)
  
  czas_tuning_elastic_net <- system.time({
    tuning_elastic_net <- tune_grid(
      elastic_net_wflow,
      resamples = validation_set_tuning,
      grid = elastic_net_grid,
      metrics = metryki,
      control = control_grid(
        parallel_over = "everything"
      )
    )
  })
  
  plan(sequential)
  
  sekundy_tuning_elastic_net <- as.numeric(czas_tuning_elastic_net[3])
  saveRDS(sekundy_tuning_elastic_net, "czasy/sekundy_tuning_elastic_net.rds")
  
  # Zapis siatki parametrów
  saveRDS(tuning_elastic_net, file = "tuning/tuning_elastic_net.rds")
  
  # Wczytanie siatki parametrów
  tuning_elastic_net <- readRDS("tuning/tuning_elastic_net.rds")
  
  best_elastic_net <- select_best(tuning_elastic_net, metric = "mape")
  
  cat("Najlepsze lambda (penalty) i alfa (mixture) - Elastic Net:")
  print(best_elastic_net) # penalty (lambda) i mixture (alfa)
  
  final_elastic_net_wflow <- finalize_workflow(elastic_net_wflow,
                                               best_elastic_net)
  
  gc()
  set.seed(2027)
  
  czas_fit_elastic_net <- system.time({
    final_elastic_net_fit <- last_fit(final_elastic_net_wflow, split = split)
  })
  sekundy_fit_elastic_net <- as.numeric(czas_fit_elastic_net[3])
  saveRDS(sekundy_fit_elastic_net, "czasy/sekundy_fit_elastic_net.rds")
  
  final_elastic_net_model <- extract_workflow(final_elastic_net_fit)
  
  # Zapis modelu
  saveRDS(final_elastic_net_model, file = "modele/final_elastic_net_model.rds")
  
  
  tabela_wspolczynnikow_elastic_net <- final_elastic_net_fit |> 
    extract_fit_parsnip() |> 
    tidy()
  
  tabela_wspolczynnikow_elastic_net
  
  wyzerowane_zmienne <- tabela_wspolczynnikow_elastic_net |> 
    dplyr::filter(estimate == 0)
  
  print(wyzerowane_zmienne)
  
})

Sys.sleep(30) # 30 sekund na odpoczynek
```

### Wyniki

```{r}

# Wczytanie modelu
final_elastic_net_model <- readRDS("modele/final_elastic_net_model.rds")

train_predictions_elastic_net <- augment(final_elastic_net_model,
                                         new_data = train) |>
  mutate(
    price_gbp = exp(car_price),
    predicted_price_gbp = exp(.pred)
  )

wyniki_elastic_net_train <- metryki(
  train_predictions_elastic_net, 
  truth = price_gbp, 
  estimate = predicted_price_gbp
) |>
  mutate(model = "Regresja liniowa (Elastic Net)",
         zbior = "Treningowy")

val_predictions_elastic_net <- augment(final_elastic_net_model,
                                       new_data = validation) |>
  mutate(
    price_gbp = exp(car_price),
    predicted_price_gbp = exp(.pred)
  )

wyniki_elastic_net_val <- metryki(
  val_predictions_elastic_net,
  truth = price_gbp,
  estimate = predicted_price_gbp
) |>
  mutate(model = "Regresja liniowa (Elastic Net)",
         zbior = "Walidacyjny")

test_predictions_elastic_net <- augment(final_elastic_net_model,
                                        new_data = test) |>
  mutate(
    price_gbp = exp(car_price),
    predicted_price_gbp = exp(.pred)
  )

wyniki_elastic_net_test <- metryki(
  test_predictions_elastic_net, 
  truth = price_gbp, 
  estimate = predicted_price_gbp
) |>
  mutate(model = "Regresja liniowa (Elastic Net)",
         zbior = "Testowy")

wyniki_elastic_net <- bind_rows(wyniki_elastic_net_train, wyniki_elastic_net_val, wyniki_elastic_net_test) |>
  dplyr::select(model, zbior, .metric, .estimate) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate)

wyniki_elastic_net
```

## Random Forest

```{r}

recipe_rf <- recipe(car_price ~ ., data = train) |>
  
  # Ochrona przed nowymi kategoriami
  step_novel(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "inne") |>
  
  # Ochrona przed brakami danych
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "nieznane") |>
  
  # Target encoding dla marki i modelu przez generalizowany model mieszany
  step_lencode_mixed(make, model, outcome = vars(car_price)) |>
  
  # Grupowanie do kategorii "inne" dla rzadkich kategorii poniżej 0,1%
  step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.001, other = "inne") |>
  
  # Profilaktyczne usuwanie stałych kolumn
  step_zv(all_predictors())



recipe_prepped_rf <- prep(recipe_rf, training = train)

train_rf <- as.data.frame(bake(recipe_prepped_rf, new_data = NULL))
validation_rf <- as.data.frame(bake(recipe_prepped_rf, 
                                    new_data = validation))
test_rf <- as.data.frame(bake(recipe_prepped_rf, new_data = test))

nazwy_predyktorow <- setdiff(names(train_rf), "car_price")
```

```{r}

callr::r(function()
{
  
  # instalacja ParBayesianOptimization (jeśli nie ma)
  if (!requireNamespace("ParBayesianOptimization", quietly = TRUE))
  {
    remotes::install_version(
      "ParBayesianOptimization",
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )
  }
  
  cores <- 6
  
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidymodels)
  library(embed)
  library(ParBayesianOptimization)
  library(ranger)
  set.seed(2027)
  
  
  split <- readRDS("dane/split.rds")
  
  train <- training(split)
  validation <- validation(split)
  test <- testing(split)
  
  cat("Train:       ", nrow(train), "\n",
      "Validation:  ", nrow(validation), "\n",
      "Test:        ", nrow(test), "\n", sep = "")
  
  
  recipe_rf <- recipe(car_price ~ ., data = train) |>
    
    # Ochrona przed nowymi kategoriami
    step_novel(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "inne") |>
    
    # Ochrona przed brakami danych
    step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "nieznane") |>
    
    # Target encoding dla marki i modelu przez generalizowany model mieszany
    step_lencode_mixed(make, model, outcome = vars(car_price)) |>
    
    # Grupowanie do kategorii "inne" dla rzadkich kategorii poniżej 0,1%
    step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.001, other = "inne") |>
    
    # Profilaktyczne usuwanie stałych kolumn
    step_zv(all_predictors())
  
  
  
  recipe_prepped_rf <- prep(recipe_rf, training = train)
  
  train_rf <- as.data.frame(bake(recipe_prepped_rf, new_data = NULL))
  validation_rf <- as.data.frame(bake(recipe_prepped_rf, 
                                      new_data = validation))
  test_rf <- as.data.frame(bake(recipe_prepped_rf, new_data = test))
  
  nazwy_predyktorow <- setdiff(names(train_rf), "car_price")
  
  
  
  zakresy_rf <- list(
    min_n = c(10L, 500L),
    mtry_prop = c(0.2, 0.9)
  )
  
  rf_parametry <- parameters(
    min_n(range = c(10L, 500L)),
    mtry_prop(range = c(0.2, 0.9))
  )
  
  set.seed(2027)
  
  init_grid_rf <- grid_space_filling(rf_parametry, size = 10) |> 
    as.data.frame()
  
  
  funkcja_rf <- function(mtry_prop, min_n)
  {
    liczba_predyktorow <- length(nazwy_predyktorow)
    
    min_n_int <- as.integer(round(min_n))
    mtry_int <- as.integer(round(mtry_prop * liczba_predyktorow))
    
    mtry_int <- max(1L, min(mtry_int, liczba_predyktorow))
    
    model <- ranger(
      formula = car_price ~ .,
      data = train_rf,
      num.trees = 500,
      mtry = mtry_int,
      min.node.size = min_n_int,
      num.threads = cores,
      seed = 2027,
      respect.unordered.factors = "order" # szybszy trening
    )
    
    predykcje_log <- predict(model, validation_rf)$predictions
    
    predykcje <- exp(predykcje_log)
    y_val <- exp(validation_rf$car_price)
    
    mape <- mape_vec(y_val, predykcje)
    
    return(list(Score = -mape))
  }
  
  
  gc()
  set.seed(2027)
  
  czas_tuning_rf <- system.time({
    wyniki_tuning_bayes_rf <- bayesOpt(
      FUN = funkcja_rf,
      bounds = zakresy_rf,
      initGrid = init_grid_rf,
      iters.n = 20,
      acq = "ei",
      verbose = 1
    )
  })
  sekundy_tuning_rf <- as.numeric(czas_tuning_rf[3])
  saveRDS(sekundy_tuning_rf, "czasy/sekundy_tuning_rf.rds")
  
  best_params_rf <- getBestPars(wyniki_tuning_bayes_rf)
  
  saveRDS(best_params_rf, "tuning/best_params_rf.rds")
  best_params_rf <- readRDS("tuning/best_params_rf.rds")
  
  
  final_min_n <- as.integer(round(best_params_rf$min_n))
  liczba_predyktorow <- ncol(train_rf) - 1
  final_mtry <- max(1L, min(as.integer(round(best_params_rf$mtry_prop * liczba_predyktorow)), liczba_predyktorow))
  
  gc()
  set.seed(2027)
  
  czas_fit_rf <- system.time({
    final_rf <- ranger(
      formula = car_price ~ .,
      data = train_rf,
      num.trees = 500,
      mtry = final_mtry,
      min.node.size = final_min_n,
      num.threads = cores,
      seed = 2027,
      respect.unordered.factors = "order" # szybszy trening
    )
  })
  sekundy_fit_rf <- as.numeric(czas_fit_rf[3])
  saveRDS(sekundy_fit_rf, "czasy/sekundy_fit_rf.rds")
  
  # Zapis modelu
  saveRDS(final_rf, file = "modele/final_rf_model.rds", compress = "xz")
  
})

Sys.sleep(30) # 30 sekund na odpoczynek
```

```{r}
wyniki_rf_test <- metryki(

wyniki_rf <- bind_rows(wyniki_rf_train, wyniki_rf_val, wyniki_rf_test) |>
```

## XGBoost

### Early stopping train

Podział zbioru treningowego na 90% do treningu i 10% do **early stopping**

```{r}

set.seed(2027)

train_split <- initial_split(
  train,
  prop = 0.9,
  strata = car_price
)

train90 <- training(train_split)
train_es <- testing(train_split)

cat("Train:                ", nrow(train90), "\n",
    "Train early stopping: ", nrow(train_es), "\n", sep = "")



recipe_boosting <- recipe(car_price ~ ., data = train90) |>
  
  # Ochrona przed nowymi kategoriami
  step_novel(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "inne") |>
  
  # Ochrona przed brakami danych
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "nieznane") |>
  
  # Usuwanie marek i modeli pojawiających się poniżej 10 razy
  step_other(make, model, threshold = 10, other = "inne") |>
  
  # Usuwanie grup factorów o udziale poniżej 0.1%
  step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), -make, -model, threshold = 0.001,
             other = "inne") |>
  
  # Profilaktyczne usuwanie stałych kolumn
  step_zv(all_predictors())


recipe_prepped_boosting <- prep(recipe_boosting, training = train90)

train_xgb_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = NULL)
train_es_xgb_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = train_es)
validation_xgb_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = validation)
test_xgb_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = test)

X_train_xgb <- train_xgb_baked |> 
  dplyr::select(-car_price)
y_train_xgb <- train_xgb_baked$car_price

train_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = X_train_xgb,
  label = y_train_xgb
)

X_es_xgb <- train_es_xgb_baked |> 
  dplyr::select(-car_price)
y_es_xgb <- train_es_xgb_baked$car_price

train_es_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = X_es_xgb,
  label = y_es_xgb
)

X_val_xgb <- validation_xgb_baked |> 
  dplyr::select(-car_price)
y_val_xgb <- validation_xgb_baked$car_price

validation_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = X_val_xgb,
  label = y_val_xgb
)

X_test_xgb <- test_xgb_baked |>
  dplyr::select(-car_price)
y_test_xgb <- test_xgb_baked$car_price

test_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = X_test_xgb,
  label = y_test_xgb
)
```

```{r}
callr::r(function()
{
  
  # instalacja ParBayesianOptimization (jeśli nie ma)

  )
  
  train90 <- training(train_split)

      "Train early stopping: ", nrow(train_es), "\n", sep = "")
  
  
  
  recipe_boosting <- recipe(car_price ~ ., data = train90) |>
    
    # Ochrona przed nowymi kategoriami
    step_novel(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "inne") |>
    
    # Ochrona przed brakami danych

               other = "inne") |>
    
    # Profilaktyczne usuwanie stałych kolumn
    step_zv(all_predictors())
  
  
  recipe_prepped_boosting <- prep(recipe_boosting, training = train90)
  
  train_xgb_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = NULL)
  train_es_xgb_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = train_es)
  validation_xgb_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting,
                               new_data = validation)
  test_xgb_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = test)

  train_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(
    data = X_train_xgb,
    label = y_train_xgb
  )
  
  X_es_xgb <- train_es_xgb_baked |> 
    dplyr::select(-car_price)
  y_es_xgb <- train_es_xgb_baked$car_price
  
  train_es_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(
    data = X_es_xgb,
    label = y_es_xgb
  )
  
  X_val_xgb <- validation_xgb_baked |> 
    dplyr::select(-car_price)
  y_val_xgb <- validation_xgb_baked$car_price
  
  validation_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(
    data = X_val_xgb,
    label = y_val_xgb
  )
  
  X_test_xgb <- test_xgb_baked |>
    dplyr::select(-car_price)
  y_test_xgb <- test_xgb_baked$car_price
  
  test_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(
    data = X_test_xgb,
    label = y_test_xgb
  )
  
  
  zakresy_xgb <- list(
    learning_rate = c(-3, -1),
    max_depth = c(4L, 10L),
    min_child_weight = c(10L, 500L),
    colsample_bytree = c(0.3, 1)
  )
  
  xgb_parametry <- parameters(
    learn_rate(range = c(-3, -1), trans = NULL),
    tree_depth(range = c(4L, 10L)),
    min_n(range = c(10L, 500L)),
    mtry_prop(range = c(0.3, 1))
  )
  
  set.seed(2027)
  
  init_grid_xgb <- grid_space_filling(xgb_parametry, size = 10) |> 
    rename(
      learning_rate = learn_rate,
      max_depth = tree_depth,
      min_child_weight = min_n,
      colsample_bytree = mtry_prop
    ) |> 
    as.data.frame()
  
  
  funkcja_xgb <- function(learning_rate, max_depth, min_child_weight,
                          colsample_bytree)
  {
    learning_rate <- 10^learning_rate
    
    model <- xgb.train(
      data = train_xgb,
      nrounds = 5000,
      evals = list(train = train_xgb, validation = train_es_xgb),
      early_stopping_rounds = 50,
      verbose = 0,
      params = list(
        objective = "reg:squarederror", # regresja
        eval_metric = "rmse", # funkcja RMSE
        tree_method = "hist", # szybszy trening i obsługa factorów
        nthread = cores,
        seed = 2027,
        learning_rate = learning_rate,
        max_depth = max_depth,
        min_child_weight = min_child_weight,
        colsample_bytree = colsample_bytree
      )
    )
    
    predykcje_log <- predict(model, validation_xgb)
    
    predykcje <- exp(predykcje_log)
    y_val_real <- exp(y_val_xgb)
    
    mape <- mape_vec(y_val_real, predykcje)
    
    return(list(Score = -mape))
  }
  
  gc()
  set.seed(2027)
  
  czas_tuning_xgb <- system.time({
    wyniki_tuning_bayes_xgb <- bayesOpt(
      FUN = funkcja_xgb,
      bounds = zakresy_xgb,
      initGrid = init_grid_xgb,
      iters.n = 20,
      acq = "ei",
      verbose = 1
    )
  })
  sekundy_tuning_xgb <- as.numeric(czas_tuning_xgb[3])
  saveRDS(sekundy_tuning_xgb, "czasy/sekundy_tuning_xgb.rds")
  
  best_params_xgb <- getBestPars(wyniki_tuning_bayes_xgb)
  
  best_params_xgb$learning_rate <- 10^(best_params_xgb$learning_rate)
  
  saveRDS(best_params_xgb, "tuning/best_params_xgb.rds")
  best_params_xgb <- readRDS("tuning/best_params_xgb.rds")
  
  
  gc()
  set.seed(2027)
  
  czas_fit_xgb <- system.time({
    final_xgb <- xgb.train(
      data = train_xgb,
      nrounds = 5000,
      evals = list(train = train_xgb, validation = train_es_xgb),
      early_stopping_rounds = 50,
      verbose = 0,
      params = list(
        objective = "reg:squarederror", # regresja
        eval_metric = "rmse", # funkcja RMSE
        tree_method = "hist", # szybszy trening metodą histogramową
        nthread = cores,
        seed = 2027,
        learning_rate = best_params_xgb$learning_rate,
        max_depth = best_params_xgb$max_depth,
        min_child_weight = best_params_xgb$min_child_weight,
        colsample_bytree = best_params_xgb$colsample_bytree
      )
    )
  })
  sekundy_fit_xgb <- as.numeric(czas_fit_xgb[3])
  saveRDS(sekundy_fit_xgb, "czasy/sekundy_fit_xgb.rds")
  
  xgb.attributes(final_xgb)
  
  history_xgb <- attr(final_xgb, "evaluation_log")
  
  best_iter_xgb <- xgb.attr(final_xgb, "best_iteration") + 1 # numeracja od 1, nie od 0
  cat("Optymalna liczba drzew dla XGBoost: ", best_iter_xgb)
  
  # Zapis modelu
  xgb.save(final_xgb, "modele/final_xgboost_model.ubj")
  
  history_xgb <- history_xgb |> 
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(train_rmse, validation_rmse),
      names_to = "zbior",
      values_to = "RMSE"
    ) |> 
    mutate(
      zbior = ifelse(zbior == "train_rmse", "train", "validation")
    )
  
  plot_xgb <- ggplot(history_xgb, aes(x = iter, y = RMSE, color = zbior))+
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8)+
    geom_vline(xintercept = best_iter_xgb, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8)+
    scale_color_manual(values = c("train" = "#1f77b4", "validation" = "red"))+
    labs(
      x = "Liczba drzew",
      y = "RMSE",
      color = "Zbiór danych"
    )+
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  return(plot_xgb)
})

Sys.sleep(30) # 30 sekund na odpoczynek
```

```{r}
recipe_boosting <- recipe(car_price ~ ., data = train90) |>
  
  # Ochrona przed nowymi kategoriami
  step_novel(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "inne") |>
  
  # Ochrona przed brakami danych
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "nieznane") |>
  
  # Usuwanie marek i modeli pojawiających się poniżej 10 razy
  step_other(make, model, threshold = 10, other = "inne") |>
  
  # Usuwanie grup factorów o udziale poniżej 0.1%
  step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), -make, -model, threshold = 0.001,
             other = "inne") |>
  
  # Profilaktyczne usuwanie stałych kolumn
  step_zv(all_predictors())
```

```{r}

callr::r(function()
{
  
  # instalacja ParBayesianOptimization (jeśli nie ma)
  if (!requireNamespace("ParBayesianOptimization", quietly = TRUE))
  {
    remotes::install_version(
      "ParBayesianOptimization",
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )
  }
  
  cores <- 6
  
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidymodels)
  library(ParBayesianOptimization)
  library(lightgbm)
  set.seed(2027)
  
  
  split <- readRDS("dane/split.rds")
  
  train <- training(split)
  validation <- validation(split)
  test <- testing(split)
  
  cat("Train:       ", nrow(train), "\n",
      "Validation:  ", nrow(validation), "\n",
      "Test:        ", nrow(test), "\n", sep = "")
  
  set.seed(2027)
  
  train_split <- initial_split(
    train,
    prop = 0.9,
    strata = car_price
  )
  
  train90 <- training(train_split)
  train_es <- testing(train_split)
  
  cat("Train:                ", nrow(train90), "\n",
      "Train early stopping: ", nrow(train_es), "\n", sep = "")
  
  
  
  recipe_boosting <- recipe(car_price ~ ., data = train90) |>
    
    # Ochrona przed nowymi kategoriami
    step_novel(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "inne") |>
    
    # Ochrona przed brakami danych
    step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "nieznane") |>
    
    # Usuwanie marek i modeli pojawiających się poniżej 10 razy
    step_other(make, model, threshold = 10, other = "inne") |>
    
    # Usuwanie grup factorów o udziale poniżej 0.1%
    step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), -make, -model, threshold = 0.001,
               other = "inne") |>
    
    # Profilaktyczne usuwanie stałych kolumn
    step_zv(all_predictors())
  
  
  recipe_prepped_boosting <- prep(recipe_boosting, training = train90)
  
  train_lgbm_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = NULL)
  train_es_lgbm_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = train_es)
  validation_lgbm_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting,
                                new_data = validation)
  test_lgbm_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = test)
  
  zmienne_kategoryczne <- train_lgbm_baked |> 
    dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
    dplyr::select(where(is.factor)) |> 
    colnames()
  
  X_train_lgbm <- train_lgbm_baked |> 
    dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
    data.matrix()
  y_train_lgbm <- train_lgbm_baked$car_price
  
  X_es_lgbm <- train_es_lgbm_baked |> 
    dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
    data.matrix()
  y_es_lgbm <- train_es_lgbm_baked$car_price
  
  X_val_lgbm <- validation_lgbm_baked |> 
    dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
    data.matrix()
  y_val_lgbm <- validation_lgbm_baked$car_price
  
  X_test_lgbm <- test_lgbm_baked |> 
    dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
    data.matrix()
  y_test_lgbm <- test_lgbm_baked$car_price
  
  
  train_lgbm <- lgb.Dataset(
    data = X_train_lgbm,
    label = y_train_lgbm,
    categorical_feature = zmienne_kategoryczne,
    params = list(feature_pre_filter = FALSE)
  )
  
  train_es_lgbm <- lgb.Dataset(
    data = X_es_lgbm,
    label = y_es_lgbm,
    reference = train_lgbm
  )
  
  
  
  zakresy_lgbm <- list(
    learning_rate = c(-3, -1),
    num_leaves = c(15L, 255L),
    min_data_in_leaf = c(10L, 500L),
    feature_fraction = c(0.3, 1)
  )
  
  lgbm_parametry <- parameters(
    learn_rate(range = c(-3, -1), trans = NULL),
    num_leaves(range = c(15L, 255L)),
    min_n(range = c(10L, 500L)),
    mtry_prop(range = c(0.3, 1))
  )
  
  set.seed(2027)
  
  init_grid_lgbm <- grid_space_filling(lgbm_parametry, size = 10) |> 
    rename(
      learning_rate = learn_rate,
      num_leaves = num_leaves,
      min_data_in_leaf = min_n,
      feature_fraction = mtry_prop
    ) |> 
    as.data.frame()
  
  
  funkcja_lgbm <- function(learning_rate, num_leaves, min_data_in_leaf,
                           feature_fraction)
  {
    learning_rate <- 10^learning_rate
    
    model <- lgb.train(
      data = train_lgbm,
      valids = list(train = train_lgbm, early_stop = train_es_lgbm),
      nrounds = 5000,
      early_stopping_rounds = 50,
      verbose = -1,
      params = list(
        objective = "regression",
        metric = "rmse",
        num_threads = cores,
        seed = 2027,
        feature_fraction_seed = 2027, # seed dla losowania cech
        data_random_seed = 2027, # seed dla danych
        deterministic = TRUE,
        learning_rate = learning_rate,
        num_leaves = num_leaves,
        min_data_in_leaf = min_data_in_leaf,
        feature_fraction = feature_fraction,
        max_depth = -1,
        feature_pre_filter = FALSE,
        force_col_wise = TRUE
      )
    )
    
    predykcje_log <- predict(model, X_val_lgbm)
    
    predykcje <- exp(predykcje_log)
    y_val <- exp(y_val_lgbm)
    
    mape <- mape_vec(y_val, predykcje)
    
    return(list(Score = -mape))
  }
  
  gc()
  set.seed(2027)
  
  czas_tuning_lgbm <- system.time({
    wyniki_tuning_bayes_lgbm <- bayesOpt(
      FUN = funkcja_lgbm,
      bounds = zakresy_lgbm,
      initGrid = init_grid_lgbm,
      iters.n = 20,
      acq = "ei",
      verbose = 1
    )
  })
  sekundy_tuning_lgbm <- as.numeric(czas_tuning_lgbm[3])
  saveRDS(sekundy_tuning_lgbm, "czasy/sekundy_tuning_lgbm.rds")
  
  best_params_lgbm <- getBestPars(wyniki_tuning_bayes_lgbm)
  
  best_params_lgbm$learning_rate <- 10^(best_params_lgbm$learning_rate)
  
  saveRDS(best_params_lgbm, "tuning/best_params_lgbm.rds")
  best_params_lgbm <- readRDS("tuning/best_params_lgbm.rds")
  
  
  gc()
  set.seed(2027)
  
  czas_fit_lgbm <- system.time({
    final_lgbm <- lgb.train(
      data = train_lgbm,
      valids = list(train = train_lgbm, early_stop = train_es_lgbm),
      nrounds = 5000,
      early_stopping_rounds = 50,
      verbose = -1,
      params = list(
        objective = "regression",
        metric = "rmse",
        num_threads = cores,
        seed = 2027,
        feature_fraction_seed = 2027, # seed dla losowania cech
        data_random_seed = 2027, # seed dla danych
        deterministic = TRUE,
        learning_rate = best_params_lgbm$learning_rate,
        num_leaves = best_params_lgbm$num_leaves,
        min_data_in_leaf = best_params_lgbm$min_data_in_leaf,
        feature_fraction = best_params_lgbm$feature_fraction,
        max_depth = -1,
        feature_pre_filter = FALSE,
        force_col_wise = TRUE
      )
    )
  })
  sekundy_fit_lgbm <- as.numeric(czas_fit_lgbm[3])
  saveRDS(sekundy_fit_lgbm, "czasy/sekundy_fit_lgbm.rds")
  
  liczba_drzew_lgbm <- final_lgbm$best_iter
  cat("Optymalna liczba drzew dla LightGBM: ", liczba_drzew_lgbm)
  
  # Zapis modelu
  lgb.save(final_lgbm, "modele/final_lightgbm_model.txt")
  
  history_train_final_lgbm <- unlist(final_lgbm$record_evals$train$rmse$eval)
  history_val_final_lgbm <- unlist(final_lgbm$record_evals$early_stop$rmse$eval)
  
  best_iter_lgbm <- final_lgbm$best_iter
  
  history_lgbm <- data.frame(
    iter = 1:length(history_train_final_lgbm),
    train = history_train_final_lgbm,
    validation = history_val_final_lgbm
  ) |>
    pivot_longer(cols = c(train, validation),
                 names_to = "zbior",
                 values_to = "RMSE")
  
  plot_lgbm <- ggplot(history_lgbm, aes(x = iter, y = RMSE, color = zbior))+
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8)+
    geom_vline(xintercept = best_iter_lgbm, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8)+
    scale_color_manual(values = c("train" = "#1f77b4", "validation" = "red"))+
    theme_minimal()+
    labs(
      x = "Liczba drzew",
      y = "RMSE",
      color = "Zbiór danych"
    )+
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  return(plot_lgbm)
})

Sys.sleep(30) # 30 sekund na odpoczynek
```

```{r}
)
```

```{r}

callr::r(function()
{
  
  # instalacja ParBayesianOptimization (jeśli nie ma)
  if (!requireNamespace("ParBayesianOptimization", quietly = TRUE))
  {
    remotes::install_version(
      "ParBayesianOptimization",
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )
  }
  
  # instalacja CatBoost (jeśli nie ma)
  if (!requireNamespace("catboost", quietly = TRUE))
  {
    remotes::install_github("catboost/catboost",
                            subdir = "catboost/R-package")
  }
  
  cores <- 6
  
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidymodels)
  library(ParBayesianOptimization)
  library(catboost)
  set.seed(2027)
  
  
  split <- readRDS("dane/split.rds")
  
  train <- training(split)
  validation <- validation(split)
  test <- testing(split)
  
  cat("Train:       ", nrow(train), "\n",
      "Validation:  ", nrow(validation), "\n",
      "Test:        ", nrow(test), "\n", sep = "")
  
  set.seed(2027)
  
  train_split <- initial_split(
    train,
    prop = 0.9,
    strata = car_price
  )
  
  train90 <- training(train_split)
  train_es <- testing(train_split)
  
  cat("Train:                ", nrow(train90), "\n",
      "Train early stopping: ", nrow(train_es), "\n", sep = "")
  
  
  
  recipe_boosting <- recipe(car_price ~ ., data = train90) |>
    
    # Ochrona przed nowymi kategoriami
    step_novel(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "inne") |>
    
    # Ochrona przed brakami danych
    step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "nieznane") |>
    
    # Usuwanie marek i modeli pojawiających się poniżej 10 razy
    step_other(make, model, threshold = 10, other = "inne") |>
    
    # Usuwanie grup factorów o udziale poniżej 0.1%
    step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), -make, -model, threshold = 0.001,
               other = "inne") |>
    
    # Profilaktyczne usuwanie stałych kolumn
    step_zv(all_predictors())
  
  
  recipe_prepped_boosting <- prep(recipe_boosting, training = train90)
  
  train_catboost_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = NULL)
  train_es_catboost_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting,
                                  new_data = train_es)
  validation_catboost_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting,
                                    new_data = validation)
  test_catboost_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = test)
  
  X_train_catboost <- train_catboost_baked |> 
    dplyr::select(-car_price)
  y_train_catboost <- train_catboost_baked$car_price
  
  train_catboost <- catboost.load_pool(
    data = X_train_catboost,
    label = y_train_catboost
  )
  
  X_train_es_catboost <- train_es_catboost_baked |> 
    dplyr::select(-car_price)
  y_train_es_catboost <- train_es_catboost_baked$car_price
  
  train_es_catboost <- catboost.load_pool(
    data = X_train_es_catboost,
    label = y_train_es_catboost
  )
  
  X_val_catboost <- validation_catboost_baked |> 
    dplyr::select(-car_price)
  y_val_catboost <- validation_catboost_baked$car_price
  
  validation_catboost <- catboost.load_pool(
    data = X_val_catboost,
    label = y_val_catboost
  )
  
  X_test_catboost <- test_catboost_baked |> 
    dplyr::select(-car_price)
  y_test_catboost <- test_catboost_baked$car_price
  
  test_catboost <- catboost.load_pool(
    data = X_test_catboost,
    label = y_test_catboost
  )
  
  
  zakresy_catboost <- list(
    learning_rate = c(-3, -1),
    depth = c(4L, 10L),
    rsm = c(0.3, 1)
  )
  
  parametry_catboost <- parameters(
    learn_rate(range = c(-3, -1), trans = NULL),
    tree_depth(range = c(4L, 10L)),
    mtry_prop(range = c(0.3, 1))
  )
  
  set.seed(2027)
  
  init_grid_catboost <- grid_space_filling(parametry_catboost, size = 10) |> 
    rename(
      learning_rate = learn_rate,
      depth = tree_depth,
      rsm = mtry_prop
    ) |> 
    as.data.frame()
  
  
  funkcja_catboost <- function(learning_rate, depth, rsm)
  {
    learning_rate <- 10^learning_rate
    
    model <- catboost.train(
      learn_pool = train_catboost,
      test_pool = train_es_catboost, # early stopping
      params = list(
        loss_function = "RMSE",
        eval_metric = "RMSE", # obserwowana metryka
        iterations = 5000,
        od_type = "Iter",
        od_wait = 50,
        use_best_model = TRUE,
        thread_count = cores,
        random_seed = 2027,
        verbose = 0,
        learning_rate = learning_rate,
        depth = depth,
        rsm = rsm,
        allow_writing_files = FALSE # brak zapisu danych na dysku przy tuningu
      )
    )
    
    predykcje_log <- predict(model, validation_catboost)
    
    predykcje <- exp(predykcje_log)
    y_val_real <- exp(y_val_catboost)
    
    mape <- mape_vec(y_val_real, predykcje)
    
    return(list(Score = -mape))
  }
  
  gc()
  set.seed(2027)
  
  czas_tuning_catboost <- system.time({
    wyniki_tuning_bayes_catboost <- bayesOpt(
      FUN = funkcja_catboost,
      bounds = zakresy_catboost,
      initGrid = init_grid_catboost,
      iters.n = 20,
      acq = "ei",
      verbose = 1
    )
  })
  sekundy_tuning_catboost <- as.numeric(czas_tuning_catboost[3])
  saveRDS(sekundy_tuning_catboost, "czasy/sekundy_tuning_catboost.rds")
  
  best_params_catboost <- getBestPars(wyniki_tuning_bayes_catboost)
  
  best_params_catboost$learning_rate <- 10^(best_params_catboost$learning_rate)
  
  saveRDS(best_params_catboost, "tuning/best_params_catboost.rds")
  best_params_catboost <- readRDS("tuning/best_params_catboost.rds")
  
  # usuwanie (jeśli istnieje) starego folderu z info o treningu catboost
  if (dir.exists("catboost_info")) unlink("catboost_info", recursive = TRUE)
  
  gc()
  set.seed(2027)
  
  czas_fit_catboost <- system.time({
    final_catboost <- catboost.train(
      learn_pool = train_catboost,
      test_pool = train_es_catboost, # early stopping
      params = list(
        loss_function = "RMSE",
        eval_metric = "RMSE", # obserwowana metryka
        iterations = 5000,
        od_type = "Iter",
        od_wait = 50,
        use_best_model = TRUE,
        thread_count = cores,
        random_seed = 2027,
        verbose = 0,
        learning_rate = best_params_catboost$learning_rate,
        depth = best_params_catboost$depth,
        rsm = best_params_catboost$rsm
      )
    )
  })
  sekundy_fit_catboost <- as.numeric(czas_fit_catboost[3])
  saveRDS(sekundy_fit_catboost, "czasy/sekundy_fit_catboost.rds")
  
  liczba_drzew_catboost <- final_catboost$tree_count
  cat("Optymalna liczba drzew dla CatBoost: ", liczba_drzew_catboost)
  
  path_train <- "catboost_info/learn_error.tsv"
  path_val <- "catboost_info/test_error.tsv"
  
  
  log_train <- read.delim(path_train)
  log_val <- read.delim(path_val)
  
  history_train_final_catboost <- log_train$RMSE
  history_val_final_catboost <- log_val$RMSE
  
  best_idx <- which.min(history_val_final_catboost)
  best_iter_catboost <- log_val$iter[best_idx] + 1 # numeracja od 0
  
  # Zapis modelu
  catboost.save_model(final_catboost, "modele/final_catboost_model.cbm")
  
  history_catboost <- data.frame(
    iter = log_val$iter + 1,
    train = history_train_final_catboost,
    validation = history_val_final_catboost
  ) |> 
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(train, validation),
      names_to = "zbior",
      values_to = "RMSE"
    )
  
  plot_catboost <- ggplot(history_catboost, aes(x = iter, y = RMSE, color = zbior))+
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8)+
    geom_vline(xintercept = best_iter_catboost, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8)+
    scale_color_manual(values = c("train" = "#1f77b4", "validation" = "red"))+
    theme_minimal()+
    labs(
      x = "Liczba drzew",
      y = "RMSE",
      color = "Zbiór danych",
      title = "Krzywa uczenia modelu CatBoost"
    )+
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  return(plot_catboost)
})

Sys.sleep(30) # 30 sekund na odpoczynek
```

```{r}

wykresy_mlp <- callr::r(function(python_path)
{
  # ścieżka do pythona, aby mieć taką samą wersję pythona w callr:r()
  Sys.setenv(RETICULATE_PYTHON = python_path)
  reticulate::use_python(python_path, required = TRUE)
  
  # instalacja ParBayesianOptimization (jeśli nie ma)
  if (!requireNamespace("ParBayesianOptimization", quietly = TRUE))
  {
    remotes::install_version(
      "ParBayesianOptimization",
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )
  }
  
  # liczba rdzeni do budowy modeli, w moim przypadku 6
  cores <- 6
  
  Sys.setenv(TF_ENABLE_ONEDNN_OPTS = "0") # brak różnic w dokładności obliczeń
  Sys.setenv(PYTHONHASHSEED = "2027") # ziarno dla Python
  Sys.setenv(TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL = "3") # tylko logi o błędach krytycznych tensorflow
  Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = as.character(cores)) # ograniczenie do 6 rdzeni
  Sys.setenv(TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS = as.character(cores)) # 6 rdzeni do obliczeń mlp
  Sys.setenv(TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS = "1") # determinizm niezależnych obliczeń
  
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidymodels)
  library(embed)
  library(ParBayesianOptimization)
  library(tensorflow)
  library(keras3)
  
  # determinizm silnika tensorflow
  tf$config$experimental$enable_op_determinism()
  
  set.seed(2027)
  keras3::set_random_seed(2027)
  
  
  split <- readRDS("dane/split.rds")
  
  train <- training(split)
  validation <- validation(split)
  test <- testing(split)
  
  cat("Train:       ", nrow(train), "\n",
      "Validation:  ", nrow(validation), "\n",
      "Test:        ", nrow(test), "\n", sep = "")
  
  set.seed(2027)
  
  train_split <- initial_split(
    train,
    prop = 0.9,
    strata = car_price
  )
  
  train90 <- training(train_split)
  train_es <- testing(train_split)
  
  cat("Train:                ", nrow(train90), "\n",
      "Train early stopping: ", nrow(train_es), "\n", sep = "")
  
  
  recipe_mlp <- recipe(car_price ~ ., data = train90) |>
    
    # Ochrona przed nowymi kategoriami
    step_novel(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "inne") |>
    
    # Ochrona przed brakami danych
    step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "nieznane") |>
    
    # Target encoding dla marki i modelu przez generalizowany model mieszany
    step_lencode_mixed(make, model, outcome = vars(car_price)) |>
    
    # Grupowanie do kategorii "inne" dla rzadkich kategorii poniżej 0,1%
    step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.001, other = "inne") |>
    
    # Zamiana pozostałych zmiennych kategorycznych na zmienne binarne
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) |>
    
    # Profilaktyczne usuwanie stałych kolumn
    step_zv(all_predictors()) |> 
    
    # Normalizacja predyktorów numerycznych
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
  
  recipe_prepped_mlp <- prep(recipe_mlp, training = train90)
  
  train_mlp <- bake(recipe_prepped_mlp, new_data = NULL)
  train_es_mlp <- bake(recipe_prepped_mlp, new_data = train_es)
  val_mlp <- bake(recipe_prepped_mlp, new_data = validation)
  test_mlp <- bake(recipe_prepped_mlp, new_data = test)
  
  X_train <- train_mlp |> 
    dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
    as.matrix()
  y_train <- train_mlp$car_price
  
  X_train_es <- train_es_mlp |> 
    dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
    as.matrix()
  y_train_es <- train_es_mlp$car_price
  
  X_val <- val_mlp |> 
    dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
    as.matrix()
  y_val <- val_mlp$car_price
  
  X_test <- test_mlp |> 
    dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
    as.matrix()
  y_test <- test_mlp$car_price
  
  
  # funkcja do resetowania stanu
  reset_mlp_fun <- function(seed = 2027)
  {
    keras3::clear_session() # czyści graf sieci i nazwy warstw
    reticulate::import("gc")$collect() # czyści pamięć Python przez reticulate
    gc()
    set.seed(seed)
    keras3::set_random_seed(seed)
  }
  
  
  
  build_mlp <- function(input_shape, num_layers, first_layer_units, 
                        width_multiplier, learning_rate, use_batch_norm)
  {
    # reset
    reset_mlp_fun()
    
    units <- integer(num_layers)
    current_units <- first_layer_units
    for (i in 1:num_layers)
    {
      units[i] <- max(8L, min(1024L, as.integer(round(current_units)))) # co najmniej 8 i maksymalnie 1024 neuronów w każdej warstwie ukrytej
      current_units <- current_units * width_multiplier
    }
    
    model <- keras_model_sequential(input_shape = c(input_shape))
    
    for (u in units)
    {
      if (isTRUE(use_batch_norm))
      {
        model <- model |> 
          layer_dense(units = u, use_bias = FALSE) |> # wyłączenie zbędnego biasu przy batch normalization dla redukcji liczby parametrów w treningu
          layer_batch_normalization() |> 
          layer_activation(activation = "relu")
      }
      else
      {
        model <- model |> 
          layer_dense(units = u, activation = "relu")
      }
    }
    
    model <- model |> 
      layer_dense(units = 1)
    
    model |> 
      compile(
        optimizer = optimizer_adam(learning_rate = learning_rate),
        loss = "mse"
      )
    
    return(model)
  }
  
  
  zakresy_mlp <- list(
    num_layers = c(3L, 5L),
    first_layer_units = c(5, 10), # skala log2 (od 32 do 1024 neuronów)
    width_multiplier = c(0.5, 1.5),
    learning_rate = c(-4, -2), # skala log10 (od 0.0001 do 0.01)
    use_batch_norm = c(0L, 1L)
  )
  
  mlp_parametry <- parameters(list(
    num_layers = new_quant_param(type = "integer",
                                 range = c(3L, 5L),
                                 inclusive = c(TRUE, TRUE)),
    first_layer_units = new_quant_param(type = "double",
                                        range = c(5, 10), # skala log2
                                        inclusive = c(TRUE, TRUE)),
    width_multiplier = new_quant_param(type = "double",
                                       range = c(0.5, 1.5),
                                       inclusive = c(TRUE, TRUE)),
    learning_rate = new_quant_param(type = "double",
                                    range = c(-4, -2), # skala log10
                                    inclusive = c(TRUE, TRUE)),
    use_batch_norm = new_quant_param(type = "integer",
                                     range = c(0L, 1L),
                                     inclusive = c(TRUE, TRUE))
  ))
  
  set.seed(2027)
  
  init_grid_mlp <- grid_space_filling(mlp_parametry, size = 10) |> 
    as.data.frame()
  
  
  funkcja_mlp <- function(num_layers, first_layer_units, width_multiplier,
                          learning_rate, use_batch_norm)
  {
    
    num_layers <- as.integer(round(num_layers))
    first_layer_units <- as.integer(round(2^first_layer_units))
    use_batch_norm <- as.logical(use_batch_norm > 0.5)
    learning_rate <- 10^learning_rate
    
    model <- build_mlp(
      input_shape = ncol(X_train),
      num_layers = num_layers,
      first_layer_units = first_layer_units,
      width_multiplier = width_multiplier,
      learning_rate = learning_rate,
      use_batch_norm = use_batch_norm
    )
    
    model |> 
      fit(
        x = X_train,
        y = y_train,
        validation_data = list(X_train_es, y_train_es),
        epochs = 500,
        batch_size = 256,
        callbacks = list(
          callback_reduce_lr_on_plateau(
            monitor = "val_loss",
            factor = 0.5, # redukcja learning rate o połowę
            patience = 10,
            cooldown = 5, # 5 epok cooldownu po redukcji learning rate
            min_delta = 1e-4, # minimalna poprawa o 0.0001, inaczej odliczanie
            min_lr = 1e-5,
            verbose = 0
          ),
          callback_early_stopping(
            monitor = "val_loss",
            patience = 25, # czas na ponad 2 redukcje learning rate
            min_delta = 1e-4, # minimalna poprawa o 0.0001, inaczej odliczanie
            restore_best_weights = TRUE
          )
        ),
        verbose = 0
      )
    
    predykcje_log <- predict(model, X_val, verbose = 0) |> 
      as.vector()
    predykcje <- exp(predykcje_log)
    y_val_real <- exp(y_val)
    
    mape <- mape_vec(y_val_real, predykcje)
    return(list(Score = -mape))
  }
  
  reset_mlp_fun()
  
  czas_tuning_mlp <- system.time({
    wyniki_tuning_mlp <- bayesOpt(
      FUN = funkcja_mlp,
      bounds = zakresy_mlp,
      initGrid = init_grid_mlp,
      iters.n = 20,
      acq = "ei",
      verbose = 1
    )
  })
  sekundy_tuning_mlp <- as.numeric(czas_tuning_mlp[3])
  saveRDS(sekundy_tuning_mlp, "czasy/sekundy_tuning_mlp.rds")
  
  best_params_mlp <- getBestPars(wyniki_tuning_mlp)
  
  best_params_mlp$learning_rate <- 10^(best_params_mlp$learning_rate)
  best_params_mlp$first_layer_units <- as.integer(round(
    2^(best_params_mlp$first_layer_units)
  ))
  
  saveRDS(best_params_mlp, "tuning/best_params_mlp.rds")
  best_params_mlp <- readRDS("tuning/best_params_mlp.rds")
  
  
  num_layers <- best_params_mlp$num_layers
  first_layer_units <- best_params_mlp$first_layer_units
  width_multiplier = best_params_mlp$width_multiplier
  learning_rate <- best_params_mlp$learning_rate
  use_batch_norm <- as.logical(best_params_mlp$use_batch_norm > 0.5)
  
  model_mlp <- build_mlp(
    input_shape = ncol(X_train),
    num_layers = num_layers,
    first_layer_units = first_layer_units,
    width_multiplier = width_multiplier,
    learning_rate = learning_rate,
    use_batch_norm = use_batch_norm
  )
  
  czas_fit_mlp <- system.time({
    history_mlp <- model_mlp |> 
      fit(
        x = X_train,
        y = y_train,
        validation_data = list(X_train_es, y_train_es),
        epochs = 500,
        batch_size = 256,
        callbacks = list(
          callback_reduce_lr_on_plateau(
            monitor = "val_loss",
            factor = 0.5, # redukcja learning rate o połowę
            patience = 10,
            cooldown = 5, # 5 epok cooldownu po redukcji learning rate
            min_delta = 1e-4, # minimalna poprawa o 0.0001, inaczej odliczanie
            min_lr = 1e-5,
            verbose = 0
          ),
          callback_early_stopping(
            monitor = "val_loss",
            patience = 25, # czas na ponad 2 redukcje learning rate
            min_delta = 1e-4, # minimalna poprawa o 0.0001, inaczej odliczanie
            restore_best_weights = TRUE
          )
        ),
        verbose = 0
      )
  })
  sekundy_fit_mlp <- as.numeric(czas_fit_mlp[3])
  saveRDS(sekundy_fit_mlp, "czasy/sekundy_fit_mlp.rds")
  
  # zapis modelu do pliku .keras
  keras3::save_model(model_mlp, "modele/model_mlp.keras", overwrite = TRUE)
  
  df_history <- data.frame(
    epoch      = 1:length(history_mlp$metrics$loss),
    train      = as.numeric(history_mlp$metrics$loss),
    validation = as.numeric(history_mlp$metrics$val_loss)
  ) |> 
    pivot_longer(cols = c(train, validation),
                 names_to = "zbior",
                 values_to = "loss")
  
  best_epoch_mlp <- which.min(history_mlp$metrics$val_loss)
  
  plot_mlp <- ggplot(df_history, aes(x = epoch, y = loss, color = zbior))+
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8)+
    geom_vline(xintercept = best_epoch_mlp, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8)+
    scale_color_manual(values = c("train" = "#1f77b4", "validation" = "red"))+
    theme_minimal()+
    labs(
      x = "Liczba epok",
      y = "Funkcja straty MSE",
      color = "Zbiór danych",
      title = "Krzywa uczenia modelu MLP"
    )+
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  return(list(history = history_mlp, plot_lr = plot(history_mlp), plot_mlp = plot_mlp))
},
args = list(python_path = python) # ścieżka do pythona z głównej sesji
)

best_epoch_mlp <- which.min(wykresy_mlp$history$metrics$val_loss)
cat("Najlepsza liczba epok treningu MLP: ", best_epoch_mlp)
wykresy_mlp$plot_lr
wykresy_mlp$plot_mlp

Sys.sleep(30) # 30 sekund na odpoczynek
```

### Wyniki

```{r}

# wczytanie modelu
model_mlp <- keras3::load_model("modele/model_mlp.keras")

preds_train_mlp <- predict(model_mlp, X_train, verbose = 0) |> 
  as.vector()

train_predictions_mlp <- data.frame(
  car_price = y_train,
  .pred = preds_train_mlp
) |>
  mutate(
    price_gbp = exp(car_price),
    predicted_price_gbp = exp(.pred)
  )

wyniki_mlp_train <- metryki(
  train_predictions_mlp,
  truth = price_gbp,
  estimate = predicted_price_gbp
) |>
  mutate(model = "MLP",
         zbior = "Treningowy")

preds_val_mlp <- predict(model_mlp, X_val, verbose = 0) |> 
  as.vector()

val_predictions_mlp <- data.frame(
  car_price = y_val,
  .pred = preds_val_mlp
) |>
  mutate(
    price_gbp = exp(car_price),
    predicted_price_gbp = exp(.pred)
  )

wyniki_mlp_val <- metryki(
  val_predictions_mlp, 
  truth = price_gbp, 
  estimate = predicted_price_gbp
) |>
  mutate(model = "MLP", 
         zbior = "Walidacyjny")

preds_test_mlp <- predict(model_mlp, X_test, verbose = 0) |> 
  as.vector()

test_predictions_mlp <- data.frame(
  car_price = y_test,
  .pred = preds_test_mlp
) |>
  mutate(
    price_gbp = exp(car_price),
    predicted_price_gbp = exp(.pred)
  )

wyniki_mlp_test <- metryki(
  test_predictions_mlp, 
  truth = price_gbp, 
  estimate = predicted_price_gbp
) |>
  mutate(model = "MLP", 
         zbior = "Testowy")

wyniki_mlp <- bind_rows(wyniki_mlp_train, wyniki_mlp_val, wyniki_mlp_test) |>
  dplyr::select(model, zbior, .metric, .estimate) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate)

wyniki_mlp
```
